plugin.avsync.apply_redeploy_title: Recreates the container: the signal is cut for the duration of the redeployment.
plugin.avsync.audio_marque_title: “Beep”: the historic 1 kHz beep — audible cue, but two beeps are indistinguishable, so a delay of a whole second is invisible. “Measurement mark”: an anchor chirp followed by tones encoding the beat number, which survives a compressed link and lets you measure inter-site A/V skew.
plugin.avsync.beat_reset: Reset Beat to its default value
plugin.avsync.flash_reset: Reset Flash + beep to its default value
plugin.avsync.probe_bands_title: Burns in bands of binary blocks spread over the height, carrying the grain index and the band number. Lets the “Latency probe” plugin measure REAL latency and detect torn grains. Can be changed while running, without redeploying. Off by default.
plugin.avsync.probe_layout_title: “Slice” stripes the picture with full-width bands: it is the only mode that measures latency line by line and detects tearing. “Edges” burns in just two framed labels at top and bottom, outside the safe area — picture preserved, but the measurement assumes the frame arrives whole.
plugin.avsync.tc_enable_title: Burns the time-of-day timecode (hh:mm:ss:ff) under the counter AND emits a wirable ANC ATC RP 188 flow (RFC 8331) — e.g. to the ANC port of a multiview window.
plugin.avsync.tone_reset: Reset Tone to its default value
type.avsync.cfg.audio_marque.help: “Beep”: the historical 1 kHz beep on the beat — a cue for the ear, but it carries NO information: two beeps are indistinguishable, so a full second of offset is invisible. “Measurement marker”: an anchor chirp followed by tone bursts encoding the beat number (64 before repeating, with a checksum). This is what makes it possible to date the audio through a COMPRESSED link, where no grain index survives — and therefore to measure inter-site A/V offset. Applied while running.
type.avsync.cfg.audio_marque.label: Audio marker
type.avsync.cfg.beat_sec.label: Beat (s)
type.avsync.cfg.chroma.label: Chroma
type.avsync.cfg.custom_text.label: Custom text
type.avsync.cfg.flash_ms.label: Flash + beep duration (ms)
type.avsync.cfg.font.help: Fed by the BobiFonts selector (image fonts + library). Changing the font redeploys the container (required to embed the bytes of a library font — ephemeral rootfs).
type.avsync.cfg.font.label: Font (branding + timecode)
type.avsync.cfg.fps.label: Rate (fps)
type.avsync.cfg.height.label: Height (px)
type.avsync.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.avsync.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.avsync.cfg.probe_bands.help: Number of binary-block bands spread over the height, carrying the grain index AND the band number. Used to measure REAL latency band by band and to detect tearing (two bands with different indices) — which a single centre timecode cannot do. 0 = disabled (default, no cost). 8 is a good value.
type.avsync.cfg.probe_bands.label: Probe bands (0 = off)
type.avsync.cfg.probe_layout.help: “Slice”: the bands span the full width, spread over the height — this is what makes it possible to measure latency LINE BY LINE (a producer in slice mode delivers the top of the frame before the bottom) and to see tearing. Intrusive: the image is crossed by bands. “Edges”: two framed cartouches, top and bottom, outside the useful area — assumes the frame arrives WHOLE (no sub-frame measurement, no reliable tearing detection), but the burn-in is discreet and readable. Applied while running.
type.avsync.cfg.probe_layout.label: Probe band layout
type.avsync.cfg.show_brand.label: Show branding (logo + name + location)
type.avsync.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.avsync.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.avsync.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour.
type.avsync.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.avsync.cfg.tc_enable.help: Burns the timecode (time of day, hh:mm:ss:ff) under the counter AND emits a wirable ANC ATC RP 188 flow (RFC 8331) — e.g. to the ANC port of a multiview window.
type.avsync.cfg.tc_enable.label: Timecode generator (burnt-in + ANC flow)
type.avsync.cfg.tone_hz.label: Beep frequency (Hz)
type.avsync.cfg.width.label: Width (px)
type.avsync.label: A/V sync test pattern
